milestones.title: v0.1.0
milestones.description: Foundation and Visual Shell using clearly labelled synthetic data.
milestones.outcome: A buildable .NET 10/WPF foundation that reproduces the approved shell, Overview slice, and widget concepts without claiming live Herdr integration.
releaseGates: Clean build and automated tests pass.
Actual WPF screenshots pass design review at 1672x941 and Windows scale factors 100%, 125%, and 150%.
The approved logo and shared application shell are preserved.
All mock data is visibly labelled Demo or Synthetic.

issues.title: [v0.1.0] Scaffold the .NET 10 solution and process boundaries
issues.outcome: Create the buildable solution structure for App, Core, CLI, Contracts, Domain, and Infrastructure.
scope: Pin the supported .NET SDK and repository build settings.
Create production and test projects with explicit dependencies.
Add build, test, format, and artifact commands.
acceptance: A clean checkout builds without manual file edits.
Project references enforce the architecture boundaries documented in Plan/ARCHITECTURE.md.
No Herdr runtime capability is claimed.

issues.title: [v0.1.0] Implement design tokens, shared shell, and ten-page navigation
issues.outcome: Implement the approved dark desktop shell and navigation contract in WPF.
scope: Create color, typography, spacing, radius, icon, and status resources.
Implement top bar, sidebar, content host, bottom status bar, and window controls.
Register all ten canonical page destinations.
acceptance: Logo and wordmark match the approved reference.
Navigation exposes all ten pages and a visible active state.
Thai text does not clip at required scale factors.

issues.title: [v0.1.0] Build the Overview visual slice with synthetic state
issues.outcome: Reproduce the approved Overview composition using deterministic synthetic data.
scope: Implement summary cards, recent activity, score trend, work distribution, top agents, and alerts.
Create deterministic sample state for visual and interaction tests.
Label the data source as Demo or Synthetic.
acceptance: Major regions and information hierarchy match 01-overview.png.
The layout remains usable at 1366x768.
No sample value is presented as live Herdr data.

issues.title: [v0.1.0] Implement widget gallery and foundation quality gates
issues.outcome: Implement the approved widget variants as testable WPF windows and establish v0.1 quality gates.
scope: Implement Compact, Normal, Expanded, Floating Mini, Floating Vertical, Notification, and Agent Detail Popup prototypes.
Add DPI, keyboard focus, contrast, reduced-motion, and window-behavior checks.
Capture repeatable visual evidence.
acceptance: Every approved widget variant can be opened from the gallery.
Always-on-top and draggable behavior is bounded and reversible.
The v0.1 release-gate test command is documented and passes.

milestones.title: v0.2.0
milestones.description: Live Herdr monitoring with snapshot, events, reconciliation, and live core pages.
milestones.outcome: HerdrOps displays real local Agent state from an installed Herdr instance and recovers correctly after disconnects.
releaseGates: Contract tests pass against the installed Herdr schema.
Actual snapshot, event subscription, disconnect, reconnect, and reconciliation traces pass.
State mappings preserve working, idle, blocked, done, and unknown/offline semantics.
Normal operation opens no localhost HTTP listener and requires no Administrator privilege.

issues.title: [v0.2.0] Discover and validate the installed Herdr protocol schema
issues.outcome: Bind HerdrOps to the schema exposed by the installed Herdr binary instead of undocumented assumptions.
scope: Discover Herdr executable and protocol metadata.
Parse snapshot, pane, agent, process, read, and subscription contracts.
Fail closed on incompatible protocol versions.
acceptance: Known compatible schema passes contract validation.
Incompatible or malformed schema produces an actionable non-zero failure.
Fixture validation is labelled contract evidence, not runtime evidence.

issues.title: [v0.2.0] Implement Herdr Named Pipe snapshot, subscription, and reconciliation
issues.outcome: Maintain accurate in-memory state from real Herdr snapshot and event streams.
scope: Open request/response and long-lived subscription connections.
Sequence events and detect gaps.
Reconnect with bounded backoff and reconcile from a fresh snapshot.
acceptance: Snapshot bootstraps all available workspaces, tabs, panes, and agents.
A forced disconnect recovers without duplicate state.
A sequence gap triggers reconciliation rather than silent continuation.
evidence: State comparison before and after reconciliation

issues.title: [v0.2.0] Add SQLite WAL state storage and Core-to-App IPC
issues.outcome: Persist bounded local state in Core and deliver snapshots/deltas to App without direct UI database access.
scope: Create forward-only SQLite schema and migrations.
Implement current-user Named Pipe IPC with versioned contracts.
Keep App and CLI from opening SQLite directly.
acceptance: Core restarts without corrupting accepted state.
App receives a full snapshot then ordered deltas.
IPC rejects invalid versions and unauthorized clients.

issues.title: [v0.2.0] Connect Overview, Live Organization, and Agent Detail to live state
issues.outcome: Drive the three initial dashboard pages from real Core state while preserving the approved designs.
scope: Replace synthetic state on supported controls with live state adapters.
Show source freshness, offline, and unknown states.
Implement live organization hierarchy and agent detail selection.
acceptance: UI values match the same Herdr snapshot used for acceptance.
Unknown data remains unknown and is not converted to success.
Closing Dashboard does not stop Core collection.

issues.title: [v0.2.0] Connect live widgets and complete runtime acceptance
issues.outcome: Deliver live Compact, Normal, and Floating Vertical widgets with measured update behavior.
scope: Subscribe widgets to Core state deltas.
Implement offline/reconnect behavior and attention badges.
Measure latency and resource budgets for v0.2.
acceptance: Widget state matches Dashboard state.
Blocked and done attention states remain distinct.
Version-local runtime gates pass on the reference Windows host.

milestones.title: v0.3.0
milestones.description: Realtime event, terminal, process, file, and Git activity with explicit provenance.
milestones.outcome: Operators can inspect realtime activity and file changes while knowing which data came from Herdr, Windows, Git, or inference.
releaseGates: Event replay is deterministic and deduplication is verified.
Actual runtime traces prove bounded terminal reads and measured event latency.
File events expose source and confidence and remain within policy scope.
Secret and redaction tests pass.

issues.title: [v0.3.0] Build the deterministic activity event pipeline
issues.outcome: Normalize, sequence, deduplicate, debounce, correlate, and replay activity deterministically.
scope: Define event envelope and source/confidence fields.
Implement high-urgency and noisy-event paths.
Add deterministic replay fixtures.
acceptance: Repeated replay produces the same state and summary.
Duplicate/noisy events are bounded without losing urgent events.
Sequence gaps remain observable.

issues.title: [v0.3.0] Implement the Realtime Activity page
issues.outcome: Implement the filtered realtime event stream, details pane, and evidence-source panel.
scope: Add filters for time, role, severity, task, and evidence level.
Render selected-event details and source links.
Support live refresh and bounded history paging.
acceptance: Layout and hierarchy match 03-realtime-activity.png.
Filter results are deterministic for the same event set.
The selected event and evidence panel remain synchronized.

issues.title: [v0.3.0] Add bounded terminal previews and Windows process telemetry
issues.outcome: Expose useful bounded pane output and process metrics without continuously capturing terminal bytes.
scope: Use pane revisions and bounded recent_unwrapped reads.
Correlate Herdr PIDs with Windows CPU, memory, and process metadata.
Apply debounce and redaction before persistence.
acceptance: There are zero unbounded terminal reads.
Process metrics identify their PID/source and expire safely.
Sensitive test strings are redacted.

issues.title: [v0.3.0] Implement scoped File/Git collectors and File Activity page
issues.outcome: Track file and Git activity inside authorized repositories and reproduce the approved File Activity design.
scope: Watch authorized repository roots and correlate paths to Agent/Task.
Capture Git status/diff metadata without mutating repositories.
Implement table, filters, charts, file details, and bounded diff preview.
acceptance: Out-of-scope paths are blocked or explicitly flagged.
File actions carry source and confidence.
UI matches 07-file-activity.png at the approved hierarchy.

issues.title: [v0.3.0] Deliver notification/popup UX and security-runtime gates
issues.outcome: Deliver Notification Widget and Agent Detail Popup with bounded alerts and complete v0.3 acceptance.
scope: Implement alert grouping, acknowledgement, and deep links.
Prevent notification floods from noisy events.
Run latency, scope, privacy, and redaction acceptance.
acceptance: Urgent alerts appear once and link to the correct event/agent.
Notification history preserves acknowledgement state.
All v0.3 release gates pass with actual runtime evidence.

milestones.title: v0.4.0
milestones.description: Delegation lifecycle, Assignment Contracts, Task Alignment, and agent self-report.
milestones.outcome: HerdrOps traces PM-to-Leader-to-Worker delegation and compares planned scope with observed work and evidence.
releaseGates: A complete PM-to-Leader-to-Worker-to-Review lifecycle is traceable.
Every graph node and edge carries provenance and time.
Missing acknowledgement, orphan task, and scope mismatch cases are detected.
CLI submissions are validated by Core and never write SQLite directly.

issues.title: [v0.4.0] Implement versioned CLI self-report contracts
issues.outcome: Provide a small CLI that submits validated assignment and evidence events to Core.
scope: Define assignment, acknowledgement, delegation, progress, deviation, evidence, and handoff commands.
Return structured acknowledgement/errors.
Evaluate Native AOT only after compatibility measurements.
acceptance: Invalid schemas and unknown tasks fail non-zero.
CLI cannot open or mutate SQLite directly.
Every accepted event receives source, sequence, correlation, and UTC time.

issues.title: [v0.4.0] Build assignment, delegation, and provenance domain models
issues.outcome: Represent tasks, roles, contracts, acknowledgements, delegations, deviations, and handoffs without losing provenance.
scope: Create versioned domain/state models.
Define lifecycle transition rules and invalid transitions.
Persist role and task relationships.
acceptance: Lifecycle transitions are deterministic and audited.
Orphans and duplicate handoffs are visible.
Historical provenance remains queryable after current state changes.

issues.title: [v0.4.0] Implement Delegation Graph and task tree
issues.outcome: Reproduce the approved task tree, delegation graph, selected-node detail, and timeline.
scope: Render role/agent nodes and typed edges.
Add pan, zoom, fit, selection, and accessible alternatives.
Render handoff details and timeline.
acceptance: Graph and detail views remain synchronized.
Blocked/review/idle/working semantics are distinct.
An accessible list/tree exposes the same information.

issues.title: [v0.4.0] Implement Task Alignment analysis and page
issues.outcome: Compare Assignment Contract, acknowledgement, planned steps, acceptance criteria, observed actions, touched files, deviations, and evidence.
scope: Implement alignment/scope analysis with explainable findings.
Render all approved Task Alignment panels.
Keep suspected misalignment separate from confirmed violation.
acceptance: Every verdict links to its supporting inputs.
Missing data does not become a passing score.
UI matches 06-task-alignment.png hierarchy.

issues.title: [v0.4.0] Deliver Expanded Widget and lifecycle acceptance
issues.outcome: Deliver the Expanded Widget and prove the complete delegation lifecycle in runtime acceptance.
scope: Show Agent, role, task/activity, elapsed time, and score from shared state.
Deep-link to Agent Detail and Task Alignment.
Run lifecycle, provenance, orphan, and mismatch acceptance.
acceptance: Widget values match the selected Agent/Task state.
A complete role-distinct lifecycle passes against actual running agents.
All v0.4 release gates pass.

milestones.title: v0.5.0
milestones.description: Compliance rules, immutable evidence metadata, and role-distinct review workflow.
milestones.outcome: HerdrOps detects explainable compliance candidates and routes them through evidence-backed Leader and PM review.
releaseGates: Rule tests cover positive and negative cases and suppress duplicates.
Suspected incidents are not confirmed without policy authority.
Evidence hash, source, actor, and reviewer identity are traceable.
Role-distinct runtime review passes.

issues.title: [v0.5.0] Implement the explainable compliance rule engine
issues.outcome: Evaluate scope, evidence, deviation, and review-order rules with explicit inputs and outcomes.
scope: Version rule definitions and severity mapping.
Implement scope violation, missing evidence, unapproved deviation, and review-order rules.
Deduplicate repeated detections.
acceptance: Positive and negative corpora pass.
Each finding records rule version and supporting facts.
Rule errors fail observable and do not silently confirm incidents.

issues.title: [v0.5.0] Build evidence metadata, hashing, and audit storage
issues.outcome: Store immutable evidence metadata and hashes linked to task, actor, event, and review history.
scope: Hash evidence with SHA-256 and record source/time.
Separate metadata from managed artifact bytes.
Create append-only review audit records and retention controls.
acceptance: Changed evidence bytes produce a different identity.
Missing artifacts remain explicit.
Review history cannot be rewritten by ordinary update flows.

issues.title: [v0.5.0] Implement the Compliance Queue page
issues.outcome: Reproduce the approved incident queue, selected incident detail, evidence list, and actions.
scope: Filter/sort by severity, state, actor, task, and reviewer.
Render incident details and evidence provenance.
Keep suspected, confirmed, pending Leader, pending PM, and dismissed states distinct.
acceptance: UI matches 08-compliance-queue.png hierarchy.
Selected row, details, evidence, and actions remain synchronized.
Actions unavailable to the current role are disabled and explained.

issues.title: [v0.5.0] Implement role-distinct Leader and PM review actions
issues.outcome: Route incidents through authorized confirm, Leader review, PM escalation, and dismiss actions.
scope: Enforce actor/reviewer separation and valid transitions.
Record reviewer identity, reason, time, and evidence set.
Notify affected views and widgets through Core state.
acceptance: Unauthorized and self-review transitions fail.
Each accepted transition creates an immutable audit event.
Leader and PM decisions remain separately attributable.

issues.title: [v0.5.0] Complete compliance privacy, retention, and runtime acceptance
issues.outcome: Validate compliance behavior, evidence integrity, retention, and redaction on actual workflows.
scope: Run incident lifecycle from suspicion through final review.
Exercise retention and diagnostic export redaction.
Measure queue consistency after restart/reconnect.
acceptance: No incident changes state without an attributable event.
Retention cannot remove records still required by an open review.
All v0.5 release gates pass.

milestones.title: v0.6.0
milestones.description: Explainable evaluation, score trends, and traceable Daily Summary.
milestones.outcome: HerdrOps calculates reproducible multi-source evaluations and daily summaries that trace back to accepted events and evidence.
releaseGates: Score formula and weights are versioned and reproducible.
Missing data never becomes an automatic passing score.
Leader, PM, and objective evidence values retain separate provenance.
Daily Summary values trace back to source events/evidence.

issues.title: [v0.6.0] Implement the versioned explainable scoring engine
issues.outcome: Calculate dimension and weighted scores with explicit provenance, missing-data behavior, and recalculation history.
scope: Implement six planned score dimensions and versioned weights.
Separate Leader, PM, objective evidence, and weighted results.
Record formula version and input snapshot.
acceptance: The same inputs produce the same score.
Missing or invalid inputs remain visible and do not default to pass.
Historical scores can be reproduced after formula changes.

issues.title: [v0.6.0] Implement the Evaluation page
issues.outcome: Reproduce score distribution, trends, dimensions, comparisons, and agent rankings.
scope: Render summary cards and charts.
Render selected task/agent comparison table.
Show highest/lowest performers with context and provenance links.
acceptance: UI matches 09-evaluation.png hierarchy.
Chart/table values reconcile to the same scoring snapshot.
Ranking ties and missing scores are handled explicitly.

issues.title: [v0.6.0] Implement Daily Summary aggregation and page
issues.outcome: Create a traceable daily summary with highlights, issues, actions, timeline, and workstreams.
scope: Aggregate accepted events/evidence by local day and workstream.
Generate repeated issues and recommended actions with source links.
Render the approved Daily Summary layout.
acceptance: Every summary number links to its source set.
Timezone/day boundaries are deterministic.
UI matches 10-daily-summary.png hierarchy.

issues.title: [v0.6.0] Add local export and complete evaluation acceptance
issues.outcome: Export evaluation/summary data locally with provenance and complete v0.6 acceptance.
scope: Export bounded human-readable and machine-readable reports.
Include formula/source versions and generation time.
Run reproducibility and traceability gates.
acceptance: Exported values match the accepted UI/query snapshot.
Sensitive data follows redaction policy.
All v0.6 release gates pass.

milestones.title: v0.7.0
milestones.description: Beta hardening, complete design parity, localization, recovery, packaging, and UAT.
milestones.outcome: A complete installable Beta that runs all approved pages/widgets reliably in Thai and English on the reference Windows environment.
releaseGates: All ten pages and approved widget variants pass human design review.
Clean-machine install, upgrade, and uninstall pass.
An 8-hour actual-Herdr soak completes without crash or unreconciled state.
Performance budgets pass or have an explicit user-approved waiver.
Human UAT passes.

issues.title: [v0.7.0] Complete ten-page and widget design parity
issues.outcome: Close visual and interaction gaps across all canonical pages and widget variants.
scope: Capture actual WPF screenshots for every page/widget.
Resolve approved-reference differences or record explicit approvals.
Verify shared status semantics and navigation consistency.
acceptance: All eleven reference entries have an accepted implementation capture.
No replacement logo or conflicting status semantics remain.
Human design review passes.

issues.title: [v0.7.0] Deliver tray, startup, settings, localization, and accessibility
issues.outcome: Complete desktop lifecycle and usable Thai/English operation across supported displays.
scope: Implement System Tray, start-at-logon, notification, widget, theme, and retention settings.
Complete Thai/English localization.
Validate keyboard, screen reader, contrast, DPI, multi-monitor, and reduced motion.
acceptance: Settings persist and are reversible.
Thai/English UI passes clipping and language-switch tests.
Accessibility checklist passes on the reference host.

issues.title: [v0.7.0] Harden crash recovery, migrations, backup, and diagnostics
issues.outcome: Recover predictably from process crashes, interrupted migrations, and damaged local state.
scope: Add migration backup and rollback safety.
Implement corrupted-state quarantine/recovery.
Create redacted diagnostic bundle and crash metadata.
acceptance: Fault-injected migration interruption preserves recoverability.
Damaged data does not cause a silent reset.
Diagnostic bundles exclude configured secrets.

issues.title: [v0.7.0] Build and validate installer, upgrade, and uninstall paths
issues.outcome: Produce a versioned Beta package with clean install, upgrade, uninstall, and startup behavior.
scope: Choose and implement the Windows packaging approach.
Version binaries and migrations consistently.
Test clean install, in-place upgrade, uninstall, and retained-user-data policy.
acceptance: Exact packaged bytes are hashed.
Clean-machine install and upgrade pass without manual repair.
Uninstall behavior matches the documented retention choice.

issues.title: [v0.7.0] Pass performance budgets, 8-hour soak, and human UAT
issues.outcome: Prove Beta reliability and usability on the reference Windows/Herdr environment.
scope: Measure CPU, working set, launch, delta latency, and reconnect budgets.
Run an 8-hour actual-Herdr soak with fault observations.
Complete user UAT and go/no-go for Beta.
acceptance: No unhandled crash or unreconciled state occurs during soak.
Budgets pass or have an explicit user-approved waiver.
Human UAT and Beta go/no-go are recorded.

milestones.title: v1.0.0
milestones.description: Stable local release with exact-artifact acceptance, 24-hour soak, privacy review, and rollback.
milestones.outcome: Publish HerdrOps v1.0.0 as a stable local Windows release whose exact artifacts passed all required gates.
releaseGates: All dependency milestones and required issues are closed with evidence.
The exact release candidate passes a 24-hour actual-Herdr soak and fault-injection suite.
Clean install, upgrade, rollback, privacy, and security reviews pass.
The user records final go/no-go approval.
Published artifacts and checksums match the accepted bytes.

issues.title: [v1.0.0] Close release blockers and audit all dependency evidence
issues.outcome: Confirm every required pre-v1 issue and gate has acceptable, version-local evidence.
scope: Audit milestones v0.1.0 through v0.7.0.
Reopen missing, stale, or wrong-artifact evidence.
Freeze the v1 release-candidate commit only after blockers close.
acceptance: No required dependency issue remains open.
Each gate links to exact evidence and commit/artifact identity.
The release candidate commit is recorded.

issues.title: [v1.0.0] Pass 24-hour soak, reconnect, and fault-injection acceptance
issues.outcome: Prove the exact v1 release candidate remains accurate and recoverable during sustained actual-Herdr operation.
scope: Run 24-hour soak on exact candidate bytes.
Inject Herdr/Core/App disconnects and process restarts.
Verify snapshot reconciliation, database integrity, and alert consistency.
acceptance: Zero unhandled crashes and unreconciled states.
Reconnect and integrity targets pass.
Any candidate rebuild invalidates and repeats the run.

issues.title: [v1.0.0] Complete final schema, privacy, and security review
issues.outcome: Approve v1 storage, migration, retention, IPC, redaction, and local-privacy behavior.
scope: Review final schema/migrations and rollback.
Review current-user pipe ACLs and absence of unexpected listeners.
Review retention, export, diagnostics, and secret handling.
acceptance: No unresolved high-severity finding remains.
Normal mode requires no Administrator privilege.
Privacy defaults and limitations are documented.

issues.title: [v1.0.0] Pass clean install, upgrade, rollback, and uninstall acceptance
issues.outcome: Validate the exact v1 candidate across supported lifecycle paths on a clean Windows host.
scope: Clean install and first-run acceptance.
Upgrade from the accepted Beta and verify data migration.
Rollback/uninstall according to documented policy.
acceptance: Every path completes without manual file repair.
Accepted data is preserved or removed exactly as documented.
Installed binaries match recorded hashes.

issues.title: [v1.0.0] Finalize artifacts, documentation, go/no-go, and GitHub Release
issues.outcome: Publish the exact accepted HerdrOps v1.0.0 artifacts with checksums and final documentation after user approval.
scope: Finalize installer, checksums, release notes, user guide, upgrade/rollback, and troubleshooting.
Obtain explicit user go/no-go.
Tag v1.0.0 and publish the GitHub Release without rebuilding accepted artifacts.
acceptance: User go/no-go is recorded.
Tag points to the accepted commit.
Published artifact hashes match acceptance records exactly.
GitHub Release is visible in OSHEThai/HerdrOps.
